gloss: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)

definitions.gloss: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)
definitions.explanation: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}{署長|しょちょう}に{就任|しゅうにん}した。
{消防|しょうぼう}{署長|しょちょう}が{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The fire chief held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {税務|ぜいむ}{署長|しょちょう}の{許可|きょか}がなければ、この{書類|しょるい}は{処理|しょり}できない。
examples.english: Without the permission of the head of the tax office, these documents cannot be processed.

notes:
The head or chief of a {署|しょ} (station/bureau). Most commonly used in the compound {警察|けいさつ}{署長|しょちょう} (police chief), but applies to any government {署|しょ} such as {消防|しょうぼう}{署|しょ} (fire station) or {税務|ぜいむ}{署|しょ} (tax office).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察|けいさつ}{署長|しょちょう}: police chief
- {消防|しょうぼう}{署長|しょちょう}: fire chief
- {税務|ぜいむ}{署長|しょちょう}: head of tax office
- {署長|しょちょう}{命令|めいれい}: chief's order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {所長|しょちょう}: director, head of an office or institute — used for research institutes, branch offices, etc.
- {局長|きょくちょう}: bureau chief, director — used for larger government agencies and broadcasting stations
- {長官|ちょうかん}: commissioner, chief — used for top-ranking government officials
